name: v4_pdebench_darcy
_comment: PDEBench 2D Darcy (DaRUS 10.18419/DARUS-2986), beta 0.1 / 10 / 100, same generator as the beta 1.0 / 0.01 files used for tuning, FRESH files. Converted by convert_v4.py darcy:<beta>: X (N,16384) = nu (coefficient a), Y (N,16384) = tensor (u), each a flattened 128 x 128 field. -div(a grad u) = beta, u = 0 on the boundary (PDEBench paper App. D.4 eq. 13-14); beta is read from the file name. Identical to the existing `darcy` preset except the name.
